title: Survey to insight
promise: Ask a question, collect answers, chart them and write up what you found.
time: About 2 hours, plus time for people to answer
audience: Researchers, product teams and community organizers

steps.title: Build the survey and collect answers
steps.why: Tally is a form builder with a generous free tier, and it can export responses as a spreadsheet when you are done.

steps.title: Chart the results
steps.why: LibreOffice Calc opens the exported responses and makes pivot tables and charts without an account or a subscription.

steps.title: Write up what you found
steps.why: A one-page summary with the chart and two or three honest conclusions is more useful than a dashboard nobody opens.
